LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsMaxDestroyDes: The chance of wrecking an implant when the surgeon has no medical ability at all. Skill scales the real chance down from here.
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsMinDestroyDes: The floor no amount of skill can go below, mirroring vanilla surgery always carrying some risk. Set to 0% to make expert extraction perfectly safe.
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsShowChance: Show the intact chance in the right-click menu
